definitions.explanation: A magazine or periodical that is published once every three months, four times a year.

examples.japanese: この{季刊誌|きかんし}は{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}の{年|ねん}4{回|かい}{発行|はっこう}される。
examples.english: This quarterly magazine is published four times a year in spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

examples.japanese: {学会|がっかい}の{季刊誌|きかんし}に{論文|ろんぶん}が{載|の}った。
examples.english: My paper was published in the academic society's quarterly journal.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{観光|かんこう}{季刊誌|きかんし}で{紹介|しょうかい}された{店|みせ}に{行|い}ってみた。
examples.english: I visited a shop that was featured in the local tourism quarterly.

notes:
{季刊誌|きかんし} is a compound of {季|き} (season/quarter) + {刊|かん} (publication) + {誌|し} (magazine). Published four times a year, once per season.

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY SERIES:
- {日刊|にっかん}: daily publication
- {週刊誌|しゅうかんし}: weekly magazine
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}: biweekly
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}: monthly magazine
- {季刊誌|きかんし}: quarterly magazine
- {年刊|ねんかん}: annual publication

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季刊誌|きかんし}を{発行|はっこう}する: to publish a quarterly
- {季刊誌|きかんし}に{掲載|けいさい}する: to publish in a quarterly

USAGE:
Used for both general-interest magazines and academic journals ({学術|がくじゅつ}{季刊誌|きかんし}). The term {季刊|きかん} alone can modify other nouns: {季刊|きかん}レポート (quarterly report).
